title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the historic streets and local businesses within walking distance of Centre College's campus in downtown Danville.

cards.entity_name: The Hub Coffee House and Cafe
cards.title: The Hub on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this local coffeehouse to study or enjoy house-made pastries while looking out at the bustling downtown neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A popular coffeehouse and student hangout on Danville's historic Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hub is described as a favorite hangout for faculty, staff, and students, featuring local art and house-made snacks.
cards.source_title: Your Centre College Visit - Visit Danville Kentucky
cards.access_notes: Open daily for coffee and light fare; check current hours for late-night study sessions.

cards.title: Dry Stack on Third Street
cards.subtitle: Third Street Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by this local roastery for fresh coffee, a highlight for first-year students during the Delve into Danville event.
cards.short_summary: A local coffee roastery and bar located on Third Street near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Dry Stack Coffee Roastery + Coffee Bar is listed as a participating business in the Delve into Danville program for students.
cards.source_title: First-year students Delve into Danville | Centre College
cards.access_notes: Located on the one-way northbound stretch of 3rd Street.

cards.title: Constitution Square on Second
cards.subtitle: Second Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the birthplace of Kentucky's statehood at this 3-acre park featuring historic log cabin replicas.
cards.short_summary: A historic park and open-air museum celebrating Kentucky's early political history.
cards.evidence_claim: Constitution Square is a 3-acre park in Danville that celebrates the early political history of Kentucky.
cards.access_notes: Public park open year-round; hosts the Great American Brass Band Festival.

cards.title: Fourth Street Development
cards.subtitle: Fourth Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this block near Main Street where the college has recently acquired property for future campus expansion.
cards.short_summary: A transitional commercial block connecting the campus to the downtown core.
cards.evidence_claim: Centre College reached an agreement to purchase a block near Main Street and Fourth Street for future development.
cards.source_title: Centre to buy block near Main St and Fourth St - Facebook
cards.access_notes: Public sidewalk access; area includes former bank and medical supply sites.

cards.title: Walnut Street Arts District
cards.subtitle: West Walnut Street
cards.notes: Attend world-class performances or view public art installations at this premier venue on the edge of campus.
cards.short_summary: Centre's primary performing arts venue located along West Walnut Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Norton Center for the Arts is located off of West Walnut Street and features public art and performances.
cards.source_title: First-year students Delve into Danville | Centre College
cards.access_notes: Parking is available behind the center off West Walnut Street.

cards.title: Mill Street Market Days
cards.subtitle: Mill Street Corridor
cards.notes: Browse local produce and handmade goods at the farmers market, a popular weekend destination for the campus community.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal market featuring local vendors and community engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boyle County Farmer's Market is highlighted as a site of interest for students in the Delve into Danville program.
cards.source_title: First-year students Delve into Danville | Centre College
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal schedules for Saturday morning market hours.

cards.title: Lexington Avenue Literacy
cards.subtitle: Lexington Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Utilize the extensive resources and quiet study spaces at the public library, located just blocks from the college.
cards.short_summary: The local public library serving as a community and student resource.
cards.evidence_claim: The Boyle County Public Library is listed as a key community partner for Centre students.
cards.source_title: First-year students Delve into Danville | Centre College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; students can obtain a local library card.

cards.title: Broadway Arts District
cards.subtitle: Broadway Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore regional art exhibits and participate in creative workshops at this community arts hub.
cards.short_summary: A regional art center offering galleries and educational programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Center of the Bluegrass is a highlighted cultural destination for the Centre community.
cards.source_title: First-year students Delve into Danville | Centre College
cards.access_notes: Galleries are generally free to the public; classes require registration.

cards.title: Maple Avenue Gateway
cards.subtitle: Maple Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Follow this historic route into town, passing local residences and small businesses that lead directly to the campus gates.
cards.short_summary: A primary residential and commercial artery leading to Centre College.
cards.evidence_claim: Maple Avenue (US-127 Business) is a main route for visitors traveling to the Admission Welcome Centre.
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; connects to Main Street at the college entrance.

cards.title: Second Street Heritage
cards.subtitle: South Second Street
cards.notes: Learn about the African-American history of the area through community events like the Soul of Second Street festival.
cards.short_summary: A historic district celebrating Danville's diverse cultural heritage.
cards.evidence_claim: The Soul of Second Street is an annual celebration of the African-American presence in the area around Constitution Square.
cards.access_notes: Public street; historical markers provide context for the district's significance.
